html:
/* Template:WeeklyTokens/styles.css - the weekly Activity Token boxes (Main Page). Dark by default, light theme below. */
.wkq { margin: 4px 0 8px; }
.wkq-top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 16px; }
.wkq-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; }
.wkq-next { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #f5cb65; }
.wkq-sub { margin: 2px 0 10px; font-size: 12px; opacity: .7; }
.wkq-boxes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 14px; align-items: stretch; }
.wkq-day { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .035); }
.wkq-dayhead { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2px 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3a3430; }
.wkq-dayname { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; }
.wkq-state { font-size: 11px; opacity: .75; }
.wkq-list { flex: 1; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.wkq-q { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 4px 0; }
.wkq-qname { min-width: 0; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.25; }
.wkq-tok { display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-weight: 700; color: #f5cb65; }
.wkq-tok img { display: block; width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.wkq-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid #3a3430; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; opacity: .9; }
.wkq-foot .wkq-tok { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0; }
.wkq-note { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; font-style: italic; opacity: .7; line-height: 1.35; }
/* the day that is active right now */
.wkq-active { border-color: #e28552; background: rgba(226, 133, 82, .1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e28552, 0 0 18px rgba(226, 133, 82, .22); }
.wkq-active .wkq-dayhead { border-bottom-color: rgba(226, 133, 82, .5); }
.wkq-active .wkq-state { opacity: 1; font-weight: 700; color: #7bd88f; }
@media (max-width: 800px) { .wkq-boxes { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
/* small version for the hero: always dark, because it sits on the darkened picture */
.wkq-mini { color: #ececec; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-top { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-title { display: block; flex: none; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f5cb65; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-title a { color: inherit; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-next { display: block; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10.5px; color: #ececec; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-sub, .wkq-mini .wkq-foot, .wkq-mini .wkq-note { display: none; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-boxes { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-day { padding: 4px 9px 5px; border-radius: 6px; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-dayhead { margin-bottom: 3px; padding-bottom: 3px; gap: 0 8px; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-dayname { font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-state { font-size: 10px; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-q { padding: 0; gap: 6px; line-height: 13px; }
.wkq-abbr { display: none; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-single { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 8px; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-single .wkq-dayhead { display: block; flex: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-single .wkq-state { display: none; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-single .wkq-full { display: none; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-single .wkq-abbr { display: inline; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-single .wkq-list { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-qname { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10.5px; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-tok { gap: 2px; font-size: 11px; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-tok img { position: static; inset: auto; width: 13px; height: 13px; object-fit: contain; }
.wkq-mini a { color: #ececec; }
.wkq-mini a:hover { color: #fff; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-title a { color: #f5cb65; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-next { color: #ececec; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-tok { color: #f5cb65; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-day { background: rgba(28, 24, 21, .88); border-color: #3a3430; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-dayhead { border-color: #3a3430; }
.wkq-mini .wkq-active { background: rgba(60, 40, 28, .92); border-color: #e28552; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e28552, 0 0 14px rgba(226, 133, 82, .3); }
.wkq-mini .wkq-active .wkq-state { color: #7bd88f; }

/* light theme */
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-next, html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-tok { color: #8a5f00; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-day { background: rgba(58, 47, 38, .04); border-color: #d9ccb0; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-dayhead, html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-foot { border-color: #d9ccb0; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-active { background: rgba(226, 133, 82, .12); border-color: #c8632d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #c8632d, 0 0 14px rgba(200, 99, 45, .2); }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-active .wkq-state { color: #2f7d3f; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-next, html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-tok { color: #8a5f00; }
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-day { background: rgba(58, 47, 38, .04); border-color: #d9ccb0; }
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-dayhead, html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-foot { border-color: #d9ccb0; }
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-active { background: rgba(226, 133, 82, .12); border-color: #c8632d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #c8632d, 0 0 14px rgba(200, 99, 45, .2); }
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-active .wkq-state { color: #2f7d3f; }
}
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-mini .wkq-next { color: #ececec; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-mini .wkq-tok { color: #f5cb65; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-mini .wkq-day { background: rgba(28, 24, 21, .88); border-color: #3a3430; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-mini .wkq-dayhead { border-color: #3a3430; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-mini .wkq-active { background: rgba(60, 40, 28, .92); border-color: #e28552; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e28552, 0 0 14px rgba(226, 133, 82, .3); }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .wkq-mini .wkq-active .wkq-state { color: #7bd88f; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-mini .wkq-next { color: #ececec; }
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-mini .wkq-tok { color: #f5cb65; }
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-mini .wkq-day { background: rgba(28, 24, 21, .88); border-color: #3a3430; }
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-mini .wkq-dayhead { border-color: #3a3430; }
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-mini .wkq-active { background: rgba(60, 40, 28, .92); border-color: #e28552; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e28552, 0 0 14px rgba(226, 133, 82, .3); }
	html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .wkq-mini .wkq-active .wkq-state { color: #7bd88f; }
}
